counting_policy: Stored rows retain their source-specific units. Shared tables appear under multiple tasks; do not add task or family row totals to count independent experiments. Explicit overlapping views are separate catalogue views.

family.data_counting_policy: Deduplicated by namespace/source-table key within this family only; row units can differ, source views can overlap and rows are not unique reactions. Inspect each binding's counting_unit and physical configuration counts.
family.data_status: local task references present; qualification varies
family.gaps: Robustness needs linked perturbations or a qualified transfer population; current response and feasibility labels do not by themselves provide that evidence. Generated negatives, expert judgments and measured failures remain separate.
family.molecular_accessibility_review: feasibility_structure.md; optional adjacent endpoint, not admitted or counted in the 41-task registry
family.scope: Yield, conversion and assay response; observed success/failure; proposal feasibility; sensitivity and transfer under declared perturbations.

task_groups.reference_policy: Observed condition-specific success and expert proposal plausibility are separate endpoints. Generated negatives remain an optional, separately reported reference tier.
task_groups.title: Reaction feasibility

family.title: Reaction outcomes, feasibility and robustness
